You may improve it to "MangaReader — Explore the latest manga chapters and discover series updates." Do not use sed. Do not create, edit, or leave any helper/script/temp files in the workspace. If the exact string is absent, inspect index.html and stop with an explanation rather than creating a script. After the edit, run git diff -- index.html and verify only index.html changed. Then immediately finish by issuing the required completion command as a separate command.
